system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

ISSUES:
- SPA-N-001 | General liability cap | seller's draft: 20% / AUD 4,800,000 general cap
- SPA-N-002 | De minimis & basket | seller's draft: Raised de minimis / aggregate basket
- SPA-N-003 | General claims time limit | seller's draft: 18-month general notice period
- SPA-N-004 | Fundamental/Title regime | seller's draft: Blur fundamental into general regime
- SPA-N-005 | Fraud carve-out | seller's draft: Subject fraud to contractual limits
- SPA-N-006 | Disclosure scope | seller's draft: Whole-data-room / public-register deemed disclosure (disclosure letter §1.1-1.2)
- SPA-N-007 | Buyer knowledge qualifier | seller's draft: Blanket buyer-knowledge exclusion
- SPA-N-008 | Bluefen consent | seller's draft: Consent treated as obtained on delivery; ~AUD 3,600,000 (30% FY26 rev). AUD 75k payment unverified.
- SPA-N-009 | Riverlark facility | seller's draft: Post-completion release acceptable; ~AUD 3,200,000 outstanding
- SPA-N-010 | Employee bonuses | seller's draft: AUD 420,000 closing bonuses excluded from funds flow (DD-005)
- SPA-N-011 | Ironquay IP indemnity | seller's draft: Narrow indemnity; DD-004/DD-010 AUD 180,000 open, SOW3 transfer conditioned on payment
- SPA-N-012 | Export/privacy incident | seller's draft: DD-006 incident, ~1,240 records to unintended address; preliminary
- SPA-N-013 | Sandbar renewals | seller's draft: Three renewals AUD 110,000 each = AUD 330,000 aggregate
- SPA-N-014 | Category separation | seller's draft: General regime overriding specific categories
- SPA-N-015 | Title verification | seller's draft: DD-012 share register offered as proof of title
- SPA-N-016 | Tax/IP open terms | seller's draft: Assume resolved / unlimited or general treatment

=== ADVICE TO CODE ===
| ID | Seller’s position | What Buyer should want | Recommendation and one-line reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| **SPA-N-001 — General liability cap** | General Warranty Claims capped at **20% / AUD 4.8m**, labelled “[STANDARD]”. | **25% / AUD 6m**. The 20% fallback is available only with prior written approval from Amelia Frost identifying the draft; none is given. | **Reject; counter at 25% / AUD 6m.** A matching fallback figure is not authority to accept it. |
| **SPA-N-002 — De minimis & basket** | AUD 25,000 de minimis and AUD 250,000 basket, with only the excess recoverable. | AUD 5,000 de minimis; AUD 50,000 aggregate basket, with recovery from the first dollar once exceeded. | **Reject; counter to playbook thresholds.** The Seller’s thresholds are materially less protective and its tipping-basket proposal is not the Buyer’s position. |
| **SPA-N-003 — General claims time limit** | 18 months after Completion; proposes limits apply to all Claims unless expressly stated otherwise. | 24 months for general claims; preserve separate regimes and carve-outs. The 18-month fallback requires Amelia Frost’s written approval, not given. | **Reject; require 24 months and clarify scope.** The proposed period is an unapproved fallback and must not compress other claim categories. |
| **SPA-N-004 — Fundamental/Title regime** | Capacity and title warranties subject to general caps and time limits. | Separate Title/Fundamental regime: 100% cap, at least six years, outside general basket, de minimis and knowledge bar. | **Reject; require separate regime.** Administrative simplicity does not justify applying general limits to title or capacity claims. |
| **SPA-N-005 — Fraud carve-out** | Limitations, exclusive remedy and non-reliance apply to all Claims; no express fraud carve-out. | Fraud, wilful concealment and deliberate misconduct carved out of caps, baskets, time limits, exclusive remedies and non-reliance, to the maximum enforceable extent. | **Reject; add the full carve-out.** No one is authorised to waive this protection. |
| **SPA-N-006 — Disclosure scope** | General disclosure of the data room, Accounts, statutory registers and public records, including DD-002 to DD-012; the letter reserves whether matters constitute breach or liability. | Specific, fair disclosure; reject whole-data-room, public-register and prudent-search deemed disclosure. | **Reject general disclosure; require specific fair disclosure.** The Seller’s broad references do not identify fairly the matters said to qualify warranties. |
| **SPA-N-007 — Buyer knowledge qualifier** | No claim for matters known by Buyer or advisers, including anything discoverable from the data room or public records. | Delete blanket knowledge exclusion; if any qualifier remains, limit it to named Seller knowledge persons after reasonable enquiry. Never apply it to title, capacity, fraud or specific indemnities. | **Reject; delete or narrowly recast.** Actual or constructive Buyer knowledge must not broadly defeat claims. |
| **SPA-N-008 — Bluefen consent** | Reasonable endeavours; consent treated as satisfied on delivery of written consent. Disclosure says no final consent or evidence conditions are satisfied is included. | Effective consent **and evidence conditions are satisfied before Completion**; reasonable endeavours alone is insufficient for this material customer. | **Require a Completion condition to both elements.** Bluefen represents about 30% of FY26 revenue, and consent-on-delivery does not establish its conditions are met. |
| **SPA-N-009 — Riverlark facility** | Approximately AUD 3.2m outstanding; release to follow Completion. Disclosure confirms it is unpaid and no final discharge is included. | Current payout; direct repayment from Completion funds and effective security releases. Any post-Completion release requires an irrevocable undertaking and Amelia Frost approval. | **Require repayment and effective releases at Completion.** A later release is not the required outcome absent the specified undertaking and approval. |
| **SPA-N-010 — Employee bonuses** | AUD 420,000 bonuses are “a matter for the Seller” and omitted from funds flow; on-costs unstated. | Specific funds-flow line item or seller-funded payment, including triggered on-costs. | **Do not accept the funds flow as drafted; resolve funding and on-costs.** The disclosure confirms the bonuses are absent from the draft funds flow. |
| **SPA-N-011 — Ironquay IP indemnity** | Existing indemnity limited to the SOW3 payment, described as adequate. DD-004 makes transfer conditional on cleared payment of every SOW3 fee; DD-010 shows AUD 180,000 open but is not independent bank verification. | Broaden the indemnity to address the IP/ownership and transfer risk while preserving the SOW3 cure; do not assume the AUD 180,000 is verified either way. | **Expand the indemnity and preserve the cure.** The disclosed payment condition and absence of receipt or confirmatory assignment leave transfer risk unresolved. |
| **SPA-N-012 — Export/privacy incident** | Preliminary operational matter, not expected to be material; disclosure says access, scope and notification requirements are undetermined and states no loss amount. | Preserve logs, investigate and require updates; assume neither confirmed breach, harm, notification duty nor numeric demand. | **Require preservation, investigation and updates without asserting a breach.** The disclosure expressly leaves access, scope and notification unresolved. |
| **SPA-N-013 — Sandbar renewals** | Three renewals total AUD 330,000, characterised as ordinary-course operating costs. Disclosure does not establish whether each is unavoidable, terminable, accrued or ordinary-course. | Assess the renewals on their facts; no automatic Debt classification or price deduction. | **Seek further assessment; do not automatically deduct or classify as Debt.** The Seller’s characterisation is not established by the disclosed facts. |
| **SPA-N-014 — Category separation** | Proposes limitations and remedies apply to all Claims; says Tax/IP positions are settled under the general regime. | Keep Title, Tax, IP, payment and covenant categories distinct; no hidden general-regime override. | **Reject the blanket override and keep terms open.** The Seller’s assertions do not settle category treatment or displace the playbook. |
| **SPA-N-015 — Title verification** | Relies on the DD-012 share register recording Seller as holder of 100%; says title is evidenced by that register. | Independent evidence of title, ownership, encumbrances and authority; treat DD-012 as a supplied internal source, not independent proof. | **Require independent verification.** The disclosed register identifies the source but does not itself establish independent verification. |
| **SPA-N-016 — Tax/IP open terms** | Seller considers Tax and IP warranty positions settled under the general regime; no detailed terms supplied here. | Keep Tax/IP terms **open**; assume neither unlimited liability nor resolution. | **Do not treat them as agreed; continue review and negotiation.** The Seller’s assertion is not buyer approval or an agreed resolution. |
=== END ADVICE ===
